newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Markka seen steady vs mark, crown, dollar.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Markka seen steady vs mark, crown, dollar.

text.p: The Finnish markka is expected to trade near its current levels against the mark and the Swedish crown at the start of next year and to be steady three months from now, too, according to a Reuters poll.
The markka was seen firming slightly against the dollar.
In the poll, 22 analysts, dealers and economists at banks and corporate treasury departments forecast DEM/FIM in a 2.90 to 3.05 range one month from now. The mean was 3.00.
Sixteen respondents expected DEM/FIM to trade between 3.00 and 3.02 at the start of 1997.
At 1600/1400 GMT, DEM/FIM traded at 2.9960 after ending at 2.9995 last Friday.
Looking three months ahead, DEM/FIM was seen around 3.02 in a 2.86-3.10 range. Four operators expected DEM/FIM to rise to 3.05 or above, while four saw it falling below 3.00.
